concepts.label: Magma primary/secondary memory-usage split
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - a mechanism, not a stat field: on a magma bucket, ep_mem_used_primary and ep_mem_used_secondary jointly partition total memory usage into 'excluding magma' and 'magma storage layer' halves; on any other bucket type the pair collapses to 'total used' plus an always-zero placeholder. The pairing and its conditional meaning is what's worth naming, not either field alone.

relations.subject: memory:magma-memory-split
relations.evidence: If this is a magma bucket, this statistic represents the memory usage of the bucket excluding magma. Otherwise, this statistic represents total memory used, in bytes.

relations.subject: memory:magma-memory-split
relations.evidence: This command returns a number of memory-related statistics, some of which are for internal use only.

notable_absence.finding: The page never defines the ep_arena / ep_arena_global stat family shown in the worked example (ep_arena:allocated, ep_arena:fragmentation_size, ep_arena:mapped, ep_arena:resident, ep_arena:retained, etc.) even though it dominates the response line count - the Stat/Description table only covers bytes, ep_kv_size, ep_value_size, ep_overhead, ep_mem_used_primary/secondary, ep_max_size, the two water marks, and the two oom-error counters. Every ep_arena* field in the actual response is left completely unexplained on this page.

cross_component_finding: The magma-vs-non-magma split for ep_mem_used_primary/ep_mem_used_secondary is the clearest storage-engine-conditional field-meaning stated anywhere in this batch: the identical field name means 'memory usage excluding magma' on a magma bucket and 'total memory used' otherwise, with the secondary field silently unused (always zero) outside magma - the same underlying couchstore-vs-magma engine boundary already promoted elsewhere in the registry, here surfacing as a semantics change on a single stat name rather than a separate field or table.
